title: Beautiful piece for the bathroom
text: Beautiful piece for the bathroom. Love this tissue holder. First it is substantial and heavy (not made cheaply). The color blends wonderfully in my cream colored and pastel guest bathroom. I have ordered more to match this piece from the collection (i.e. the wastebasket and cup). I will be doing reviews on them when they arrive this week. I have nothing bad to say, InterDesign makes a quality product.

product_metadata.title: InterDesign York Bath, Boutique Box, Vanilla
features: Open bottom allows easy replacement for empty tissue boxes
description: InterDesign 's York Collection has a clean design that complements all styles. The elegant contrast of the Vanilla and Bronze finish complements the traditional shape of the collection.
